composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a compact diorama with one short wooden bridge spanning two smooth pebbles over a small blue-green glass pool. Angle the bridge diagonally and keep all pieces within one unified base. Render wood slats, polished stone and clear glass distinctly under broad soft light. The scene is unoccupied and unmarked, using quiet ivory surroundings rather than a full landscape. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
